_comment: Annotated maps shown by the demo. Each entry points to a map file in this folder; "story" marks maps that also have a narrative. The 144-map collection is in collection.json, generated by scripts/build_collection.py.

title.la: Tartariae sive Magni Chami regni typus
title.en: Map of Tartary, or of the Kingdom of the Great Khan

maps.creator: Abraham Ortelius
maps.repository: Boston Public Library, via Internet Archive
maps.summary: Reading edition. All 40 texts engraved on the map, and Ortelius's description of Tartary printed on the back, each in Latin as engraved, with abbreviations written out and an English translation. Read from the scan by an AI model (Claude Opus 5.5) and scored against the published edition.

maps.creator: John Speed, engraved by Dirck Grijp
maps.repository: Bibliothèque nationale de France, via Wikimedia Commons
maps.summary: Reading edition. All 43 texts on the map (title, town views, costume figures and 26 notes, from the Dutch voyages to Nova Zembla to the Great Wall) and Speed's description of Tartary printed on the back, each as engraved or printed and in modern spelling. Read from the scan by an AI model (Claude Opus 5.5); the passages checked against the scan match word for word.

title.fr: Carte generale de la Siberie et de la Grande Tartarie
title.en: General map of Siberia and Great Tartary

maps.creator: French copy of a lost Russian map
maps.repository: Newberry Library, Chicago (Ayer MS map 30, sheet 115)
maps.summary: Reading edition. A Russian map of Siberia known only from this French manuscript copy: the Russian names written in French, and the tents of the Yakuts, Tungus, Kalmyks and Mongols. Its notes, peoples and regions are pinned on the map, and its 264 towns, rivers and lakes can be shown on demand, each as written and in English. Read from the scan by an AI model (Claude Opus 5.5); the faded scan has its contrast adjusted, with the original one click away.

title.en: Complete Map of the Myriad Countries of the World

maps.creator: Matteo Ricci 利瑪竇, with Li Zhizao 李之藻
maps.repository: Library of Congress, Geography and Map Division
maps.summary: Feature demonstration, September 2026: transcriptions and translations are illustrative. Woodblock print on six sheets, the third edition of Ricci's Chinese world map. Chinese inscriptions throughout: title, prefaces, cosmological diagrams and hundreds of place names.

title.zh: 米勒地圖集 第四葉
title.en: Nautical Atlas of the World (Miller Atlas), folio 4

maps.creator: Lopo Homem, Pedro and Jorge Reinel; illuminated by António de Holanda
maps.repository: Bibliothèque nationale de France (via Library of Congress / World Digital Library)
maps.summary: Feature demonstration, September 2026: transcriptions and translations are illustrative. A vellum sheet painted on both sides: the recto shows the Magnus Sinus (the Great Gulf of the Chinese sea), the verso the China Sea with the Moluccas. Latin cartouches on both faces.
